result.summary: A dark-themed developer application interface with three visible areas: a left panel showing the 'Agent' product description and bottom chat input; a middle settings sidebar with account info and a vertical navigation menu (Conversation is highlighted); and a right settings content pane titled 'Conversation' with toggle rows and dropdowns for To-Do List, Auto Fix Lints, Agent Questioning Proactively, Code Review, and Terminal Tool Preferences. A top bar shows 'SOLO', 'Select Project', and Editor/Settings/Agents tabs.
